_seller_display_name_note: Not part of the change set. The public seller name comes from the seller profile in the AWS Marketplace Management Portal. Kept here as a record of the intended name.
_logo_url_note: Must be a direct, publicly readable S3 URL. GitHub raw URLs are rejected with INVALID_MEDIA. Set by 03_upload_logo.sh.
support_description: Email contact@leanmcp.com for support. We answer during business hours on weekdays. Include your instance ID, AWS Region, and the output of 'sudo journalctl -u pine -n 200' when reporting a problem.
refund_policy: No refund by default; you pay only for the hours you use. In exceptional cases, such as a defect in the software, we may issue a refund at our discretion. No refunds after 7 days.
_pricing_rule: Base rate is $1.40/hour for any instance with fewer than 4 vCPU. At 4 vCPU and above the rate scales proportionally with vCPU count: price = 1.40 * (vCPU / 2). Add new instance types to both lists below using the same rule.
release_notes: First AWS Marketplace release of the Pine capture server.
